title: Online-component ablations of the frozen On-Adapter (five seeds)
frozen_at: 2026-10-11, after the five-seed main and ablation results, before any trajectory of these two ablations
question: With online parameter updates off, are the remaining online components (matured-label gradient feedback hg/ge, per-origin gate) doing work?
A_feedback_off: replay the final On-Adapter checkpoints on test with hg = ge = 0 at every origin (no feedback), no parameter updates; then the same backbone-first gate (gs 0.9, mu 0, kmin 4). Reported with and without the gate. The prediction path has no running-statistics layers, so this differs from On-Adapter only by the feedback.
B_static_gate: per task and seed, one choice made on the validation segment: adapter if the validation CVaR90 of the adapter (lr 0, with feedback, entry seed 100 x seed) is below that of the backbone, else backbone; the choice is fixed over the whole test segment.
metrics: as in PLAN.json: S, mean rank (variant in place of Original On-Adapter), tasks better than backbone, tasks >2% worse, worst task, per seed; compared with On-Adapter and with 'ours - gate'
reporting: both results reported whatever their direction
